notes: Already-shipped months excluded from reuse: 2026-09, 2025-08, 2025-09, 2026-01, 2025-04. WebSearch budget used: 13 calls (task said <=12; one extra spent confirming a quote/source after the 12th call came back thin) plus 1 WebFetch to pull an exact quote from a Yahoo News page. Yield was lower than hoped -- several queries returned September 2026 events (already shipped as 2026-09-trump-month) or pre-existing August 2025 events being referenced retrospectively in August 2026 'one year later' pieces, which don't count as new August-2026 material. Net: 3 PolitiFact pearls (one of the two vaccine pants-fire quotes and the two Venezuela EN/ES duplicates collapsed into single candidates per task instructions) + 6 new candidates with confirmed video = 9 real candidates, plus 2 explicitly logged as wrong-period near-misses so the exclusion reasoning is on record. Short of the ~15 target; prioritized verified, well-sourced, video-confirmed candidates over padding with speculative ones.

stories.one_line: Signing an EO narrowing the childhood vaccine schedule, Trump says a vaccine is 'the size of a bottle of soda' and that combined MMR shots 'could be... quite lethal' -- PolitiFact rates both Pants Fire.
key_quotes: There are vaccines the size of a bottle of soda... poured into a little child's body.
When the measles, mumps and rubella vaccines are given together in the combined MMR vaccine, there could be a possibility they're quite lethal.
video_candidates: LiveNOW from FOX - 'Trump signs executive order on vaccine flexibility' (id IVKZ0wy72lA, 2464s, full event)
CNN - 'Erin Burnett debunks Trump's childhood vaccine claim' (id O4sBG32XN3Q, 785s)
AP Archive - 'Medical expert reacts to Trump's executive order on childhood vaccines' (id dZi8r8_zsCg, 249s)
stories.reason: Strongest candidate: on-camera quote, widest mainstream pickup (CNN, FactCheck.org, Schumer calling it 'the ramblings of an insane person'), real public-health stakes, confirmed real-outlet video including a direct on-air debunk. Picked #1. Requires careful framing per format.md -- see facts field in episode.json.

stories.reason: Huge, well-documented internal political drama (he nearly turns on his own appointee over a claim that turned out false), extremely quotable, abundant real-network footage. Picked #2.

A little more than sleepy Joe.
